citations.quote: The Borrower shall not permit the Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio, measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended, to be less than 1.20 to 1.00.

"Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio" means, for any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters, the ratio of (a) EBITDA for such period minus Unfinanced Capital Expenditures and cash paid for income taxes for such period to (b) the sum of cash paid for interest and scheduled principal payments on term debt for such period.
The Borrower shall not permit the Total Leverage Ratio, measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter, to exceed 3.00 to 1.00.
"Total Leverage Ratio" means, as of any date, the ratio of (a) Total Debt as of such date to (b) EBITDA for the period of four consecutive fiscal quarters then ended.
The Borrower shall not make Capital Expenditures in an aggregate amount exceeding $12,000,000 in any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters, measured as of the last day of each fiscal quarter.
"Capital Expenditures" means, for any period, purchases of property and equipment by the Borrower during such period.

citation.quote: As soon as available, and in any event within 120 days after the end of each fiscal year, the Borrower shall deliver to the Lender audited financial statements of the Borrower for such fiscal year, accompanied by an unqualified opinion of independent certified public accountants acceptable to the Lender.

As soon as available, and in any event within 45 days after the end of each of the first three fiscal quarters of each fiscal year, the Borrower shall deliver to the Lender internally prepared financial statements of the Borrower for the fiscal year to date.
Within 45 days after the end of each fiscal quarter, the Borrower shall deliver to the Lender a Compliance Certificate signed by its chief financial officer.

clause_index.quote: "EBITDA" means, for any period, net income of the Borrower for such period plus, to the extent deducted in determining net income for such period, interest expense, income tax expense, and depreciation and amortization, all determined in accordance with GAAP.

"Total Debt" means, as of any date, the sum of the outstanding principal amount of the line of credit, the current portion of long-term debt, long-term debt net of current portion, and Subordinated Debt of the Borrower as of such date.

Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, the Lender agrees to make revolving loans to the Borrower from time to time until the Revolving Maturity Date in an aggregate principal amount at any time outstanding not to exceed $9,250,000.
The Lender has made a term loan to the Borrower on the Closing Date in the original principal amount of $34,592,000.

The Borrower shall repay the Term Loan in consecutive quarterly installments of $736,000 each, payable on the last day of each fiscal quarter, with the remaining unpaid balance due and payable on the Term Maturity Date.
